column1: # THE DRIFT GATE'S FIXED SEEDS (the owner, 2026-11-04: "a gate that only fails on what the change adds"). Each country's
# `takes-drift-1` / `takes-drift-2` rows replay the seeds this file assigns them (column `row`), on every run, and fail
# only on a flip the change adds over its base on the same seeds (scripts/ci/identity-drift-check.sh). The explorer
# (.github/workflows/identity-drift-explorer.yml) appends a seed that found a NEW flip (scripts/ci/drift_seeds.py add),
# so the gate grows. Each seed costs its row one replay (ES ~2 min, PL ~6, the US/UK ~8-12, DE ~16): the initial set is
# the seeds that ever found a flip that fit today's rows, plus spread seeds where none had. Read by scripts/ci/drift_seeds.py.
